human_actions_pending.context: The design, implementation plan, history API, operator UX shell, timeline rail, white-card layout fixes, and live verification for 4A-01 are all complete.

decisions.decision: Phase 4 is split into 4A and 4B rather than one monolithic follow-up phase.
decisions.rationale: 4A first solves visibility/history/operator UX so 4B planning intelligence can be made visible and testable instead of opaque.

decisions.decision: 4A should focus on explainability/history UX before stronger planning intelligence.
decisions.rationale: The user’s strongest pain is not whether Kairos did work, but that the frontend does not make its work and reasoning visible.

decisions.decision: The user wants both strong operator-facing explainability and stronger visible planning intelligence, but in sequence rather than in one giant phase.
decisions.rationale: This keeps execution and validation manageable while preserving the long-term goal of making Kairos both visibly and actually more intelligent.

next_action: Commit the completed 4A-01 implementation/docs on main, then either continue refining the left-column cockpit rendering or begin detailed 4B planning from the approved spec.
context_notes: Phase 4A plan 01 is no longer just planned; it has been implemented and verified. The codebase now has a session history API, parsed timeline entries, a split operator console shell, white-card controls/layout fixes, and live history evidence. The next session should build on this baseline rather than recreating the initial 4A planning work.
